ns2:course.label: Vet Diagnostic Path 2
ns2:course.description: (VP 446) Instruction in diagnostic pathology for pathology majors. Instruction based on necropsy cases with emphasis on recognition, description, and interpretation of gross and microscopic lesions; evaluation of results of other diagnostic assays; disease pathogenesis; and final case diagnosis and comments. May be repeated to a maximum of 10 hours. Prerequisite: VP 545 and consent of instructors based on satisfactory performance and commitment to the program.
